text: Added tests for the middleware as suggested.

Thanks for the detailed review!

- Fixed response state tracking by overriding Write() in addition to WriteHeader()
- Added a test case for panic after Write() to ensure the response is not overwritten
- Logged JSON encoding errors using logging.LogError to match existing patterns
- Added a test for panic with an error type to cover the type assertion branch
- Enriched panic logs with method and request_id for better debugging context

All changes are minimal and follow the existing code style. Tests pass locally.
